title: Flatness of the internal regular coefficient module supported on the diagonal
statement: For a commutative condensed ring object Lambda and a scheme Y whose diagonal surface W is Noetherian, the internal module source Lambda Y = Delta_* Lambda_P of def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category is flat in Mod(W,Lambda_W). No flatness or nonzero hypothesis on Lambda is imposed.

source.place: Paragraph (1), closed diagonal supported coefficient source; supported-source normalization in the diagonal tower trace

proof.text: Exact closed and complementary open inverse images jointly detect zero objects: underlying abelian sheaves are detected by closed support. Exactness then lets them detect invertibility through kernels and cokernels.

Both module restrictions are strong monoidal. Transport the two tensor functors across their monoidal comparisons and reflect their exactness jointly. This proves that a module with flat closed and open restrictions is flat.

Restrict the regular diagonal coefficient along the canonical coefficient pullback isomorphism. It remains regular and hence flat. Closed localization identifies the closed restriction of its direct image with this input and the open restriction with zero. The previous criterion proves flatness, and the actual coefficient/direct-image comparison transports this to source Lambda Y.
